name: C069 Vũ Công Nghi Lễ (Song Phiến Luân Nghi Lễ Chiến Trận)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Ritual War-Dancer's bladed sun-fan chakram dagger (Song Phiến Luân Nghi Lễ Chiến Trận - C069 Vũ Công Nghi Lễ) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete ornate ritual war-fan blade oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (wrapped crimson-and-gold grip handle with a brass ring pommel) to top-right (a crescent fan of razor-sharp gilded bronze feathers and turquoise wind-runes).
- Must show 100% of the entire weapon from bottom handle ring to top fan-blade tips with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the weapon itself (use burnished gold, dark bronze, crimson silk wrap, and glowing turquoise-jade wind runes).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring a matching pair of the exact same Gilded Ritual War-Fan Blades (Song Phiến Luân Nghi Lễ Chiến Trận - C069 Vũ Công Nghi Lễ) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Showcase two matching gilded bronze ritual war-fan blades crossed dynamically in the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a torch-lit temple ceremonial stage with swirling turquoise wind-haste ribbons and golden sparks.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
